risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively transparent and quantitatively supported, including capital spending, shareholder returns, shipment expectations, and liquidity-related amounts. The tone is cautiously positive but acknowledges material risks from aerospace destocking, automotive production, metal-cost inflation, pricing pressure, and operational disruption at Trentwood. Extensive definitions of non-GAAP measures and non-run-rate items add boilerplate and may complicate interpretation of underlying performance.
